message.content: Based on the discussions reported, there is no explicit mention of new species of flowers that will be included in the community garden renovation project. However, several types of flowers are proposed for inclusion, such as lavender, coneflowers, and native plants. Li Hua suggests incorporating a variety of colorful annuals alongside native plants to make the garden vibrant throughout the year. Additionally, she mentions the potential addition of a small herb section to make the garden more functional and enjoyable for cooking purposes. The focus appears to be on enhancing the aesthetic appeal and functionality of the garden rather than introducing entirely new species of flowers.
